jp: 母[はは]{と|to-with}{は|wa-contrast}よく映画[えいが]{を|o-object}見[み]ます{が/けど|ga-but}、父[ちち]{と|to-with}{は|wa-contrast}見[み]ません。
en: I often watch films with my mother, but not with my father.
why: は after と contrasts the two companions: films with my mother, none with my father.

jp: 日本[にほん]{に/へ|ni-destination}{は|wa-contrast}来[き]ました{が/けど|ga-but}、富士山[ふじさん]{に|ni-destination}{は|wa-contrast}まだ登[のぼ]っていません。
en: I have come to Japan, but I haven't climbed Mt. Fuji yet.
why: は after に contrasts Japan with Mt. Fuji: I got to one but not yet up the other.
